861:t_060:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then go ahead and take your break. I'm counting on you again next time, too.」

861:t_060:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is this all right, XO?」

861:t_061:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Good work, players. Even though we are enemies, I pay my respects to the way you fought this time.」

861:t_061:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Would you rather not hear praise from an opponent you've fought to the death?」

861:t_061:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A good reaction. But also a reckless one.」

861:t_061:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You will surely become a worthy rival to me. I await the day we decide the victor on the map.」

861:t_061:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「By then, you will have come to know my true intent as well.」

861:t_062:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...What's wrong? That's not like you, $$バナージ$$.」

861:t_062:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I did my best... I really did! I gave it everything! And this is the result!」

861:t_062:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I raised my levels, boosted my kill count, and earned funds and Z-Chips, too!」

861:t_062:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What more am I supposed to do!? What am I supposed to fight!?」

861:t_062:9.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Oh boy... He's really worn out.」

861:t_062:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You lot, take your breaks regularly so you don't end up like this.」

861:t_063:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Quitting, you say...? But you haven't cleared the game yet...?」

861:t_063:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Let me see the pride of an SRW player.」

861:t_063:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「If you have the courage, return at once and resume the game.」

861:t_063:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$! You shouldn't talk like that! You'll only drive others, and yourself, into a corner!」

861:t_063:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's take a little break. You're tired, too.」

861:t_063:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Player! That's how it is, so we'll excuse ourselves now!」

861:t_064:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Somehow I managed to clear this map, too...」

861:t_064:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it took quite a while, didn't it?」

861:t_064:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Slow, $$バナージ$$. At that speed, it looks like I will see the end of this story before you do.」

861:t_064:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm getting used to SRW little by little, too! I won't let you do that!」

861:t_064:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well. Then from here on, it's a race. Now, if you'll excuse me for today.」

861:t_064:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Players. So that $$フル・フロンタル$$ doesn't get ahead of us, I hope you will resume as soon as you can.」

861:t_064:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm asking you, too! The outcome of this battle depends on you!」

861:t_065:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Another game over, $$バナージ$$? Haven't you been grinding enough?」

861:t_065:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think so, too, but... It's always like this...」

861:t_065:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「'But,' 'even so'... everything I do thinking that ends up backfiring. At this rate, there'll be a map I can never clear someday...」

861:t_065:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then retry after the game over. That way you can carry over your funds and levels.」

861:t_065:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I didn't know there was such a way...」

861:t_065:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You can start over as many times as you like. People... and games...」

861:t_065:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But retrying after a game over forfeits the chance to earn SR Points. Just be careful about that.」

861:t_065:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Well then, good luck. $$バナージ$$... and you players, too.」

861:t_066:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, I hear you have learned what the Box really is. Please tell me, what is the Box?」

861:t_066:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「There's no way I can tell you that...!」

861:t_066:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why not? I should have the right to know, too.」

861:t_066:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Take a good look in front of the screen, $$ミネバ$$! The players are watching this exchange!」

861:t_066:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「There must still be players who don't know what the Box really is... And yet I can't just go and spoil it for them!」

861:t_066:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then I have no choice but to see the Box's true nature for myself. Together with the players.」

861:t_066:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Everyone... To learn the truth, please lend me your strength. I await the resumption of the game.」

861:t_067:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn! Why do the enemy's attacks hit this much!?」

861:t_067:4.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, did you properly upgrade your unit's Mobility?」

861:t_067:5.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Making steady preparations to win a battle. I consider that a soldier's duty, too.」

861:t_067:6.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Don't you agree, $$ダリル$$, $$ワッツ$$?」

861:t_067:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Both of them took off the moment they heard what you just said, Captain.」

861:t_067:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「Heh heh... Looks like the $$トライスター$$ aren't prepared enough either.」

861:t_067:10.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Mmm... Players, make sure that doesn't happen to you.」

861:t_068:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「A break, huh... Hmph... What a carefree fellow.」

861:t_068:4.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Since you're struggling against high-Mobility enemies, let me teach you one useful thing.」

861:t_068:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「If you want to land your attacks, raise 'Accuracy' with unit upgrades. Well, even then it wouldn't work on the Colonel.」

861:t_068:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So that's how it is. If the Colonel has sortied, give up on clearing the game and...」

861:t_068:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...If you use the Spirit Commands 'Strike' or 'Intuition', you can hit even $$フロンタル$$, though...」

861:t_069:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Probably tired out, I guess... From this endlessly dragging war...」

861:t_069:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...I'll end this war, I swear!」

861:t_069:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「With the power of the $$ユニコーン$$, the beast of possibility...! So...!」

861:t_069:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm talking about 'SRW.' No matter how hard you try, it's pointless unless the player resumes the game.」

861:t_069:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So that's how it is, players. So $$バナージ$$'s drive isn't wasted, come back soon.」

861:t_070:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let's call it here for today.」

861:t_070:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Pardon me, but... is there some reason? If not, I'd like you to continue the game.」

861:t_070:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You! Do you mean to object to the Colonel's decision!?」

861:t_070:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's all right, Captain $$アンジェロ$$. $$バナージ$$ is talking about one's attitude toward the game.」

861:t_070:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「True, I can't deny it feels half-finished... Above all, aren't you yourself eager to know what comes next?」

861:t_070:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That is... Am I obliged to answer?」

861:t_070:9.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You've been running your mouth this whole time! Don't underestimate us, brat!」

861:t_070:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Dear me... It seems we do need a little rest after all.」
